preconditions.description: The size of the array a and the number of queries must be between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array a must be between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r, k in queries_of_type_1)
preconditions.description: For each query of type '1', the indices l and r must satisfy 1 <= l <= r <= n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 10**5 for l, r, k in queries_of_type_1)
preconditions.description: For each query of type '1', the value of k must be between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= n for p, x in queries_of_type_2)
preconditions.description: For each query of type '2', the index p must satisfy 1 <= p <= n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**5 for p, x in queries_of_type_2)
preconditions.description: For each query of type '2', the value of x must be between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], int) for i in range(len(output)))
postconditions.description: Each output must be an integer.
Each output must be greater than or equal to -1.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (output[i] >= 0 and output[i] <= 10**5) for i in range(len(output)))
postconditions.description: Each output must be either -1 or a value between 0 and 10^5.
